Source: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1666507
Access: readable in browser on2026-10-06T19:10:50.939Z.

The old UI supported simple primary/subkey structures with common expiry. Complex keys may deliberately use different dates; blindly updating all keys can revive an intentionally expired subkey. Thunderbird owns its keyring; editing a key in external GnuPG does not automatically sync those changes (1762834 discussed separately). This patch lets users select one component of a complex key. No automated expiry test added in this commit. Reviewer and author manual checks are historical reported validation, not tests run by this study.
